original_identity.old_text: - A supplier that is UAE-registered (TRN on the invoice) charges UAE VAT in the normal way: Box 9, not Box 3.

corrected_destinations.text: - Do not decide reverse charge from a TRN alone. Check the supplier's residence, the place of supply, who accounts for VAT and any domestic reverse charge. A valid UAE tax invoice for a normal domestic standard-rated purchase belongs in Box 9; a TRN does not override Article 48.

original_identity.old_text: - Services supplied in a Designated Zone are treated as supplied inside the UAE: 5% as normal. Water and energy too.

corrected_destinations.text: - A Designated Zone does not automatically put services outside UAE VAT. Article 51(6) treats their place of supply as inside the UAE, subject to the tightly conditioned shipping/delivery exception in Article 51(7). Apply the normal rate or exemption rules, rather than assuming every service is 5%. Water and energy are inside the UAE under Article 51(8).

original_identity.old_text: **Consequence of failing:** a QFZP that fails any condition, or elects out, is taxed at the standard rates from the start of that tax period **and for the four following tax periods**.

corrected_destinations.text: **Consequence of failing:** failure of a condition removes QFZP status from the start of that period and for the next four periods (MD 229/2025 Article 5). An election to use standard rates takes effect from the current or following period under Corporate Tax Law Article 19; the election-duration rules are a separate unconfirmed hold below.
